Mission Statement
Our mission is to establish and maintain a foundation of accurate and reliable geographic information and systems. We strive to enhance county projects, empower local businesses, and improve services for residents through collaborative, innovative, and efficient GIS solutions.
Vision Statement
Our vision is to be a trusted resource for Wright County departments, government agencies, and the public, delivering accessible and accurate GIS solutions. We are committed to supporting informed decision-making, fostering sustainable growth, and enhancing the county's development through reliable and impactful mapping services.
This diagram shows how GIS data is organized into layers, including point address data, line street centerlines, parcel polygons, elevation grids, and aerial imagery
